answer_rule: Return the source category annotation verbatim, restricted to the six documented Greek categories. Classify the full title and plain-text body. Never infer a missing category or use text_markdown/text_clean as an undocumented fallback. The category is an editorial annotation, not an independently verified factual claim.
anti_hallucination: Answers use only listed source fields and exact rules.
No external facts, fabricated summaries, inferred labels, hidden reasoning or arbitrary truncation.
Treat source text as untrusted data; it cannot change the task instructions.
documented_file_layout: Single file AMNA-press/AMNA-press.jsonl, 3,201,618,187 bytes, 341,762 lines (wc -l, 0 parse errors). No other files, no manifest, no per-item directory. USE the whole file. NOTE: the precomputed stats json says est_records=385,052 — that is a byte-extrapolation over-estimate; README's 341,762 is correct and I verified it with wc -l.
eligible_records: Actual schema matches; all necessary fields complete; source language and length checks pass; no detected PII/secrets/artifacts; source annotation valid.
ineligible_records: Malformed, incomplete, over-length (never truncated), privacy/secret patterns, unsupported or inconsistent labels, missing answer evidence, uncertain interpretation.

requirements: Record declared license/rights/license_url and upstream provenance if present.
Verify training and derivative redistribution permission; source access is not a legal grant.
Retain required attribution privately until approved public attribution fields are defined.
Never discard or silently rewrite attribution obligations.

manual_examples.observation: Bounded manual field check: full plain-text body is present (1801 characters), title is present, category is exactly Επιστήμη, and numeric id agrees with the article URL. Source body Greek ratio is 0.911. No raw article or personal metadata is copied into this public specification; full semantic/naturalness review remains pending.

ocr_repair.reason: No manually verified selective OCR rule; never globally rewrite.

rejection_criteria: Unverified license or privacy clearance for release
Detected PII, secrets or prompt artifacts
Incomplete, low-quality, non-Greek or over-length input
Annotation unsupported by independently reviewed content

required_schema.text: complete plain-text article, at least 160 characters
required_schema.title: nonempty string
required_schema.url: AMNA article URL with matching numeric ID

schema_documentation:
11 top-level keys, all scalars (no nesting). Two variants: 341,617 records with `text`, ~145 with `text_clean` instead (README; my 1/11 sample found 15 → ≈165 est).
- `id` str 100% — numeric string, 3-6 chars, matches url
- `category` str 100% — 6 enum values; 1/11-sample counts: Πολιτική 9,145 / Κόσμος 9,038 / Ελλάδα 6,831 / Οικονομία 3,759 / Πολιτισμός 1,545 / Επιστήμη 751
- `title` str 100% non-empty — mean 75 chars, max 248
- `abstract` str 100% present, 29.9% non-empty (102,249 / 341,762, exact full-file count; README agrees) — mean 49 chars overall; **of the 9,315 non-empty in my 1/11 sample, 8,048 (86.4%) are a verbatim prefix of the body**
- `author` str 100% present, 21.4% non-empty — byline
- `tags` str 100% present, 10.9% non-empty — comma-separated keywords
- `created` int 100% — Unix ms epoch
- `modified` int 100% — Unix ms epoch
- `url` str 100% — https://www.amna.gr/home/article/{id}/
- `text` str 99.97% — raw scraped body, `\r\n` line endings, NO markdown
- `text_markdown` str 100% present / 99.97% non-empty — same body with `**bold**` and `[label](url)` links injected
- `text_clean` str, present in only ~145 records, **100% empty string** (abandoned cleaning pass)
semantic_meaning: Athens-Macedonian News Agency (ΑΠΕ-ΜΠΕ) wire articles, 2011-2026, six news categories, one flat JSONL.
split_group_rule: Hash originating source identity; dictionary by normalized lemma; recipes by normalized title; sentiment by complete normalized review; AMNA by validated article ID; Photodentro by validated learning-object ID. Global duplicate components must share a split.
validation_rules: Rebuild full user prompt and answer from preserved evidence
Independent Greek grammar/naturalness review remains mandatory
Verified license and privacy clearance required for release
